status.proved: a theorem in model/Laws, pinned by vectors
status.settled: decided in the design ledger, not built yet

nouns.purpose: Say one thing an observer saw, so anyone can check it and nobody can change it.
nouns.state: An envelope the core reads, a payload it never interprets, a signature. Named by r: and a hash of the envelope and the payload's commitment.
nouns.principle: Its id hashes what it says, written canonically: spell a set another way and the id doesn't move. Erase its payload and the id, the signature and every record citing it still hold.

nouns.state: A typed reference on every record, usually a lineage id sl:….
nouns.principle: Nothing a record says is true; it is said, by its observer. Two observers disagreeing is two records, both kept.
nouns.pending: Keys checked at read, and standing, arrive in step 3.

nouns.purpose: Give each subject its own state, so records about different things never interfere.
nouns.state: A typed reference, prefix:value, in a record's about. A record about nothing anchors a thing named by its own id.
nouns.principle: Revise a thing's record and the revision is its head. Revise one record twice and the thing has two heads, a fork, until a record names both.

nouns.purpose: Hold records, and nothing else: it owns no meaning.
nouns.state: A set of records, kept in places, each record one canonical line.
nouns.principle: A store is a set. Read its places in any order and a reader settles the same records, one per id.

nouns.purpose: Let readers who hold different payloads still agree on what is current.
nouns.state: What one reader holds: each record with its payload, withheld, or erased. Envelopes are always held.
nouns.principle: A view folds to the same heads as a reader holding everything. What it can't read it counts as unread, never guesses.

nouns.purpose: Write a standing question as data anyone can check.
nouns.state: vertex, the sources in from, the slots in fold.
nouns.principle: An accepted spec's parsed form parses back to itself. A refused one names the first rule it breaks, and where.

nouns.purpose: Choose records by their envelopes alone.
nouns.state: A store, then optionally the kinds and the thing it is about.
nouns.principle: A source takes a record when its kind is listed and it is about the thing. A view selects exactly the same records.

nouns.state: A name, one fold, and optionally where, follow and limit.
nouns.principle: The same set of records gives every slot of every spec the same value. A slot over heads never brings back a superseded record.

nouns.purpose: Turn a set of records into state.
nouns.state: One of six: count, sum, min, max, in the accumulating family; latest-by, over heads; and collect, over heads when it follows prev and over every selected record when it doesn't.
nouns.principle: The set decides: arrival order and two-way syncs never change the answer, and a late record folded onto the cached state gives what folding the whole set again gives.

nouns.purpose: Ask a standing question over stores: select, fold, tick.
nouns.state: A spec run over what a reader holds.
nouns.principle: Run it on the same set and it gives the same slots, each with how many records it couldn't read.
nouns.pending: Naming a vertex by its spec's hash, and when it ticks, are settled, not built.

nouns.purpose: Fix a vertex's result at a moment, so others can cite it.
nouns.state: The vertex, the records it covers, listed exactly, and the result; an id over all three.
nouns.principle: Anyone holding the covered records recomputes the same tick.

nouns.purpose: Turn state into text people edit, and edits back into records.
nouns.state: A render, a parse and a diff by ids; the base the text came from.
nouns.principle: Parse a render and you get back what was rendered. A dropped section changes nothing: absence is never an edit.
nouns.pending: Keyed sections are proved; applying edits as records is settled.

nouns.purpose: Give standing ahead of time, with a scope.
nouns.state: A record; a record acting on it names it in under.
nouns.principle: A record without standing stays visible but has no effect.

verbs.says: Write a record: checked, signed, appended. Nothing else enters a store.
Fix a vertex's result at a boundary, as a value anyone can recompute.
Say no, with a code from a closed set and the path of what broke the rule. Never guess.
Turn the forms a reader's places hold into one record per id, payload kept unless erased.
Refuse records not entitled to their prev. Standing joins it in step 3.
A source takes the records its store, kinds and thing choose.
A where test answers yes, no, or, on a payload the reader lacks, unknown.
Turn what was taken into a slot's value.
Walk prev within a thing to its heads: what nothing about it replaces.
Write state as text for an audience.
Read edited text back, refusing what it can't read.
Turn the edits a parse found into records, emitted together.

constructions.says: A new chain. About nothing, the record anchors a thing of its own.
Replace x within a thing both are about. Naming one about other things is refused, prev-unrelated.
Nobody's verb: a state. The thing has two heads, both shown, the newer by content order winning.
Any kind may. x keeps its id, signature and place; only its opening goes.

constructions.made: hold a record without its payload
constructions.says: Not a write at all: a view. Envelopes still answer every test on them.

layers.name: Text
layers.gist: For an audience: what a lens renders, and what people edit.

layers.name: Tick
layers.gist: A result at a moment, covering exactly the records folded.

layers.name: State
layers.gist: A vertex's slots, worked out from the set.

layers.name: View
layers.gist: What one reader holds, settled and admitted.

layers.name: Store
layers.gist: A set of records in places. No order, no positions.
layers.lasts: as long as a place keeps it

layers.name: Record
layers.gist: The ground. Appended, never edited; only a payload can go.

refusals.note: named in the laws, no vector

provenance.here: Every noun has one purpose, its own state and an operational principle: the card's three lines.
The grammar comes first, as nouns and verbs, and the object–action matrix shows where they meet.
Objects and operations only: no file formats, commands or screens.
The form: nouns, verbs and layers, each layer as high as it is temporary, and a walk taken step by step.
